jobs.title: Associate Director, Client Data Team
jobs.description:
About MUFG Investor Services

Experience something Brilliantly Different.

At MUFG Investor Services, we partner with some of the world’s most sophisticated public and private funds to help them operate with confidence and scale. We bring together fund administration, banking, and operational expertise to solve complex challenges across the alternatives space.

With over $1 trillion in assets under administration
and a global presence across 17 locations
, we combine deep industry knowledge with the strength of MUFG — one of the world’s largest financial institutions with approximately $3 trillion in assets
.

Here, you’ll do work that matters from day one. You’ll collaborate with smart, driven teams, build your expertise across complex fund structures, and grow your career in an environment that values curiosity, accountability, and new ideas. To learn more, visit us at www.mufg-investorservices.com.

Job Description

In this role, you will assist the Business Data Office – Client Data Team fulfilling mandate of ingesting and maintaining static data for clients, Data Migration and remediation, solution verification, testing and investment data maintenance for Fund of Funds.

Acknowledge and complete requests for data updates from stakeholders (Client Integration & Operations)
Assist accounting and operations team in capturing and maintaining client and investment data
Assist with regular data clean up, bulk ingestion or data migration.
Work with guidance from director to assess solutions and assist in legacy replacement and modernization initiatives (For in-house systems: Origin and MTC)
Validate data update requests and communicate missing or invalid info back to requesting user.
Extract and/or Collect data from various structured and unstructured formats (csv, PDF, email) and ingest into appropriate system.
Collaborate with Data Integrity & Operation to resolve data incidents and assist with data remediation efforts.
Adhere to standard operating procedure when updating MUFG system
Update Operating Procedures and maintain JIRA/ServiceDesk/Confluence up to date
Assist in standardizing and simplifying processes for creating and maintaining client and investor data.
Participate in multiple initiatives with Technology, Product and other stakeholders to digitize and automate the ingestion and maintenance of client and investor data.
Ensure internal checklists are completed and signed off.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Technical or Analytical fields
Minimum 6+ years' experience in financial services data management with people management experience
Experience in back office OR business processing practices

Additional Information

What’s in it for you to join MUFG Investor Services?

Take a look at our careers site and you’ll find everything you’d expect from a career with the fastest-growing business at one of the world’s largest financial groups. Now take another look. Because it’s how we defy expectations that really defines us. You’ll feel that difference in all kinds of ways. Our vibrant CULTURE. Connected team. Love of innovation, laser client focus, and next-level LEARNING & DEVELOPMENT. Oh, and we really walk the talk when it comes to HYBRID WORKING.   

So, why settle for the ordinary? Apply now for a Brilliantly Different career.

We are committed to using Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools responsibly and being transparent about what we do to build trust and confidence. At MUFG Investor Services, we use AI tools to support our recruitment process by helping us understand how well candidates’ applications align with the requirements of the role.

All AI recommendations are reviewed by our recruitment team before any decisions are made.

More information on our use of AI tools is available in our Privacy Notice available to you as part of your application.

We thank all candidates for applying; however, only those proceeding to the interview stage will be contacted.

MUFG is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Workshop Director - CIO Advisory / AI
jobs.description:
Position Purpose

Infotech's members come to us for our advisory services, value added research, and our passion for driving measurable business results. If you are looking to be part of an IT research firm that relentlessly creates innovative advisory products and transformational IT research solutions, we would like to speak with you. You will work for a rapidly growing company that understands the importance of supporting employees through flexibility, inclusiveness, learning and development, internal career mobility, measurement of the Employee Experience and actioning on employee feedback and building strong relationships.

Due to continued growth in our workshop offering, we are expanding our team of talented professionals to support our member base. We offer a high learning, dynamic, and progressive culture focused on evolving the field of information technology. This role is ideal for someone who -

Excels in Leveraging practical experience to improve client strategies, processes, and project execution.
Has subject matter expertise in one of more of the following subject areas.
Strategy and governance; leadership; project portfolio management; enterprise architecture; service management; service desk; IT operations; infrastructure management; data management; enterprise applications; application development; security and risk management.

Excels in facilitating and engaging cross-functional groups of IT and business professionals via interactive presentations, training and/or workshops.
Excels in Learning and flexibly communicating IT best practices to meet the needs of diverse organizations, industries, situations, and audiences.

What You Will Do, Includes, But Not Limited To

As a Workshop Director you will be actively engaged in delivering measurable value to Infotech's members by utilizing our IT Best Practice methodologies, detailed in our Blueprints, to deliver online or on-site structured 1-week workshops designed to help improve their strategies, processes, and organizational effectiveness.

Duties & Responsibilities

Engagement Scoping: Work with clients over the phone to properly scope and formalize the objectives, agenda, deliverables, and overall workshop effort in advance of online or onsite delivery.
Workshop Delivery: Lead the delivery of four-day workshops, online or onsite, based on Infotech’s Best Practice Methodology Blueprints.
Work with client cross-functional teams to define the scope and outcomes of their IT initiatives / projects, perform capability maturity assessments, and gap analyses, and identify member improvement opportunities/recommendations.
Client Service: Identify client need for continued advisory service and support after the workshop.
Assist in the development of Statements of Work to formalize the objective, agenda, and deliverables of workshops.

Commercial Activity: Identify opportunities to provide additional advisory services, workshop, consulting engagements, and services to our clients after the workshop.
Research Support: Transmit new knowledge and lessons learned during workshop interactions to influence and improve the research agenda and content. On occasion, develop client case studies and/or industry research notes.
Contribute to Infotech research by developing client case studies and/or industry research notes.
Generate insight and providing expertise to assist with the development of our research content.

Collaboration & Support: Work collaboratively with others to:
Design and build high-quality keynote/other presentations, and successful delivery of presentations as needed.
Play a lead role in building internal AI capabilities at Infotech, including internal agent development, tool prototypes, knowledge sharing and AI-enhanced workflows.

Education & Experience

To be successful, you will need:

Undergraduate degree in Business, IT, or related discipline. MBA is an asset or equivalent.
Minimum of 5-10+ years progressive experience in IT leadership OR consulting roles within medium to large organizations (IT team size between 25 and 500 FTEs).
Consulting roles within large organizations is a definite advantage
Acquired experience in more than one of the following areas:
IT Strategy, IT Governance (COBIT, ITIL), Organizational Structure, Digital Business, IT Cost, IT Risk Management, Business Relationship Management, Service Catalog, Service Management,
AI Strategy, AI Governance, AI Literacy, Agentic AI, various AI tools knowledge,

Especially valuable experience (definite advantage) in more than one of the following:
Enterprise Architecture, Security, Zero Trust, Ransomware, Risk, Privacy, Information Security,
IT Service Desk/Operations, Infrastructure/Cloud Strategy, Disaster Recovery Planning, Asset Management, Cloud Operations, Incident & Problem Management,
Data Strategy, Data Governance, Enterprise Content Management,
Application Development, Enterprise Application (ERP/HRIS/CRM/ECM) selection and Implementation, Rationalization, SDLC,
Agile, Project Portfolio Management, Resource Management, Digital Product,

Superior interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, exceptional ability to work well with others.
The ability, flexibility, and enthusiasm to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing, and energetic environment.
Previous experience presenting to a C-Suite audience.
Certifications in an IT or project management related topic e.g. PMP, COBIT 5, ITIL are considered beneficial
Deep understanding of current and emerging technologies, how other enterprises are employing them to drive digital business, and how they may be applied to the enterprise to drive digital business.

Skills

Client Interaction and Facilitation; Ability to build rapport and communicate effectively with clients and particularly through the facilitation of workshops online or in-person with an audience of 5 to 20 clients (mid management to executive management).
Exceptional presentation, facilitation, writing, interpersonal communication, and collaboration skills.
Public Speaking ability to speak to a larger group (50+) of individuals

Problem solving; decision making, knowledge management, managing through change & uncertainty and dynamic learning mindset
Client Advisory and Service Delivery; lead multiple clients through complex projects by providing guidance, critical analysis, and support
Proven ability to build rapport, credibility, and trust with clients at all levels and across all disciplines. Build client relationships and established themselves as a trusted advisor (SME) in their space
Opportunity Identification and Definition; lead multiple clients through structured working sessions; can facilitate an inclusive discussion in order to meet clear objectives
Project Management; ability to work independently and remotely for extended periods of time.

Travel Requirement:
This role will involve travel, for on-site engagements. Willingness and ability to travel 50% of the time (2 weeks per month) is required. Must hold a valid driver’s licence.

Visa Requirement:
Must be eligible to obtain appropriate work Visa for cross-border work within North America and globally.

Work Hours Requirements:
Must be available for after-hours work periodically to service Global (Americas/EMEA/APAC) clients.

Language Skills
: Bilingual proficiency in French, Spanish or German is preferred to support our diverse client base across North America and globally.

Infotech Group of companies is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status or characteristic including Minority/Female/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/Disability/Veteran and are pleased to consider all qualified applicants. To that end, upon request, Infotech will ensure, to the extent possible, that accommodation be made available to applicants throughout the recruitment and hiring process.

jobs.description:

.

This is a senior leadership position reporting directly to the Global Chief Operating Officer, with significant exposure to the Board and wider executive leadership team. The successful candidate will lead the firm's digital transformation strategy, bringing together business applications, data, AI, automation and digital client services to deliver measurable business improvements.

This is not a traditional IT infrastructure or operational technology role. An established CTO is responsible for those areas. The focus of this appointment is on strategy, development, transformation and execution

You will take responsibility for developing and delivering a global digital transformation strategy across legal, corporate and trust services. Working with senior business stakeholders, you will turn commercial and operational challenges into practical technology solutions that improve efficiency, client experience and service delivery.

You'll inherit an established application development team and will be responsible for developing its capabilities as the transformation programme progresses.

Significant projects are already underway, including a major entity-management platform initiative, a broader data management and analytics programme, and opportunities to extend the use of AI and automation across the business.

Develop and deliver a global digital strategy and transformation roadmap aligned with business priorities.
Lead and develop the existing Business Technology and Application Development team.
Own the business applications roadmap, including entity management and client-facing technology solutions.
Oversee the design, development and delivery of new systems, whether built internally, purchased or delivered through external partners.
Drive the data strategy, analytics, reporting and business intelligence agenda.
Identify and implement practical AI and automation opportunities across legal and professional services.

What We're Looking For
We are particularly interested in senior digital transformation and business technology leaders from professional services, legal, fiduciary/corporate services, financial services or similarly complex, regulated environments
.

You will bring:
Significant experience leading digital strategy, business technology or enterprise transformation.
A proven track record of delivering complex technology programmes with measurable business outcomes.
Strong experience across business applications, software development and technology-enabled process improvement.
A solid understanding of data strategy, analytics, business intelligence, AI and automation.
Experience leading multidisciplinary development teams and managing external delivery partners.
The ability to influence Board-level stakeholders while remaining technically credible and close to delivery.

Toronto is the mandatory location, with this being an in-office role. with Bermuda also an option for suitably qualified candidates.

This is an opportunity to shape the digital direction of an established international professional services organisation, with direct access to senior leadership, an existing development capability and significant transformation programmes already underway.

jobs.title: Chief Artificial Intelligence Architect
jobs.description:
The Bank is accelerating its transformation by placing artificial intelligence at the core of its business and technology strategies. AI is a key enabler for innovation, operational efficiency, and hyper-personalized customer experiences. To support this ambition, we are creating a strategic role dedicated to shaping the Bank’s AI architecture vision.
The rapid evolution of generative and agent‑based AI introduces new architectural, operational, and risk challenges that cannot be addressed through traditional solution or data architecture practices alone. This role exists to ensure the Bank can leverage AI at scale, at speed, and within its risk appetite, while preserving security, regulatory compliance, ethical standards, and enterprise coherence .

You are a senior architect recognized not only for your ability to combine strategic vision with deep technical expertise in AI, but also for your strong leadership presence and your ability to influence peers, executives, and multidisciplinary teams. You thrive in uncertainty and fast‑moving environments, consistently demonstrating initiative, sound judgment, and accountability. You are comfortable taking decisions, assuming responsibility for them, and constructively challenging internal stakeholders as well as vendors, partners, and suppliers to protect the Bank’s interests and raise the quality of outcomes. You balance time‑to‑value with risk management, challenge the status quo when needed, and foster collaboration across disciplines. You operate naturally at the executive level, leveraging your credibility, clarity, and structured approach to create real impact through your leadership and vision.
Your role
: 

Define and evolve the Bank’s enterprise AI architecture strategy, roadmap, and reference architectures in alignment with business priorities, enterprise architecture, and risk appetite.
Establish pragmatic AI principles, guardrails, and reusable patterns that accelerate delivery while ensuring consistency, reuse, and control across the organization
Lead the architectural vision for generative and agentic AI, ensuring solutions are secure-by-design, auditable, and operable at enterprise scale.
Define enterprise patterns for agentic systems, including autonomy boundaries, human-in-the-loop controls, lifecycle management, and safe-stop mechanisms.
Partner with AI delivery, governance, business, data, and technology stakeholders to drive a coherent enterprise AI approach, clarify decision rights, and translate opportunities into scalable golden paths.
Advise executives on AI-related investments, platform and vendor choices, adoption sequencing, and trade-offs between speed, control, and risk.
Oversee AI risk management, emerging technology assessment, and architectural escalation for complex or high-risk AI initiatives.

Your team: 

 As Chief AI Architect, you are accountable for defining and driving the Bank’s enterprise AI architecture strategy, including the reference architectures, guardrails, and scalable patterns required to enable AI adoption and operationalization across the organization. Reporting to the Chief Architect, you ensure that AI solutions can scale safely, remain aligned with enterprise standards, and operate within the Bank’s risk appetite.

Prerequisites
:

Minimum of 15 years of experience in enterprise and/or solution architecture, including significant hands-on experience in AI-related domains.
Deep expertise in AI technologies, including machine learning, generative AI, agent-based systems, and the enterprise platforms required to operationalize them.
Strong understanding of AI governance, ethics, regulatory constraints, and risk management in large organizations.
Demonstrated experience designing AI reference architectures, defining enterprise guiding principles, and shaping scalable architectural patterns.
Solid knowledge of data platforms, MLOps / LLMOps, and cloud-native AI services such as AWS and Azure.
Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence executives and senior peers, challenge stakeholders constructively.

Languages: French, English
Reason to require this language: you will need to discuss frequently with our service providers or partners who speak a language other than French.
Required skills: Architecture Governance, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Computing, Cloud-native Architecture, Coaching, Decision Making, Diversity & Inclusion, Domain-Driven Design, Empathy, Enterprise Architecture, Event Driven Architecture, Initiative, Mobilization, Resiliency, Solution Architecture, Teamwork, Web Architecture

Your benefits

In addition to competitive compensation, upon hiring you’ll be eligible for a wide range of flexible benefits to help promote your wellbeing and that of your family such as:

* Health and wellness program, including many options
* Flexible group insurance
* Generous pension plan
* Employee Share Ownership Plan
* Employee and family assistance program
* Preferential banking services
* Involvement in community initiatives
* Telemedicine service
* Virtual sleep clinic

We have an offer that keeps up with trends as well as your needs and those of your family.

Our dynamic work environments and cutting-edge collaboration tools foster a positive employee experience. We value employees’ ideas. Whether through our surveys or programs, regular feedback and ongoing communication are encouraged.

Making a bold move in a people-first environment

We’re a bank on a human scale that stands out for its courage, entrepreneurial culture, and passion for people. Our mission is to have a positive impact on people’s lives. Our core values of partnership, agility, and empowerment inspire us, and inclusion is central to our commitments. We aim, wherever possible, to provide a barrier-free and accessible environment to all employees.

We strive to provide accessibility measures throughout the recruitment process within the limits of our available resources. If you require accommodations, feel free to let us know during our initial conversations. We welcome all candidates! What can you bring to our team?

Join us!

Do you currently work for Canadian Blood Services? All employees must apply via the internal career page.

Together, the work we do connects people and changes lives — including your own.

Be part of a dynamic, collaborative and caring organization committed to saving and improving lives. Thousands of patients depend on us every day for reliable access to safe blood, plasma, stem cells and organs and tissues.

About The Role

Canadian Blood Services is seeking a Regular Full-Time Associate Director, Portfolio Governance and Value Realization
to join our Enterprise Portfolio, Program and Project Management Office (ePMO)
team in our Ottawa or Toronto office.

The ePMO
team delivers programs and services that advance valuable organizational initiatives, ensuring they are completed on time and on budget. Our focus is on maximizing business outcomes for Canadian Blood Services and the people in Canada we serve.

As the Associate Director, Portfolio Governance and Value Realization, you will lead value realization and benefits tracking activities aligned with corporate strategy, corporate funding cycles, and the delivery of high-visibility projects and programs across the organization.

Reporting to the Director, Enterprise Program Enablement & Project Management Office, you will lead ePMO-led value realization activities across enterprise programs and provide guidance to support value-informed decision-making. You will contribute to enterprise portfolio management and reporting for all corporate priority projects, including ePMO projects; escalate issues requiring executive attention; and provide leadership to enterprise projects coordinated through process management. You will also ensure compliance with corporate portfolio reporting requirements and support the execution of select projects within the portfolio by fostering collaboration and integration across divisions. In addition, you will provide a challenge function across other ePMO activities, including reporting, automation and artificial intelligence (AI), data and analytics, and alignment with corporate strategy.

Formula for success

Leveraging your skills in ePMO operations, you will oversee value realization driven through programs, providing leadership, coordination, and management of enterprise PMO processes and functions.
Applying your expertise in value realization leadership, you will oversee the development of proposals and business cases, as required, to help articulate anticipated benefits and the value proposition.
Demonstrating your skills in influencing and negotiating, you will motivate and coach staff for high performance, act with transparency, and promote a problem-solving mindset and collaborative culture.
Utilizing your experience in benefits management and performance measurement, you will ensure all centrally delivered projects and programs have defined benefits, measured using key performance indicators, tracked, and communicated in a consistent and effective manner, and incorporate effective change and risk management controls.
Drawing on your skills in project interdependency management and prioritization, you will identify, manage, and address interdependencies between projects and prioritization to drive the greatest value.
Demonstrating your ability to lead with empathy and emotional intelligence, you will apply the advanced soft skills required to lead and motivate others to achieve deliverables, particularly when priorities and expectations may be in conflict.
Contributing your expertise in strategic initiatives and project leadership, you will take a lead role in developing and maintaining various initiatives and participate in special projects and corporate initiatives as assigned by the Director.
Applying your skills in performance improvement and governance, you will identify opportunities to improve performance and apply fit-for-purpose processes that balance governance and empowerment.
Fostering your strengths in people leadership and talent development, you will create a high-performing, engaged, and inclusive team environment by setting clear expectations, developing talent, supporting career growth and succession planning, and promoting continuous learning, collaboration, and professional development.
Applying your analytical and problem-solving skills, you will use your seasoned experience and knowledge to analyze highly complex problems, interpret business needs, and develop integrated, innovative solutions. This will often require deeper investigation of conflicting information and novel thinking to establish solutions.

Desired Education And Skills

A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Science, Public Administration, Health Administration, or a related discipline. A master’s degree (MBA, MPA, MSc, or equivalent) is considered an asset. An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.
A minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience managing multiple projects and programs involving large teams, significant budgets, and multiple stakeholders, including at the executive level.
Demonstrated ability to build and lead teams, including managing, coaching, and developing project managers, employees, and contracted resources.
Proven ability to manage a significant project portfolio within a large organization, with a focus on value realization and measurable business outcomes.
Demonstrated success in establishing and maturing value-driven portfolios and programs that support organizational transformation and strategic objectives.
Expertise in process transformation and service delivery, including the ability to develop recommendations and present outcomes to executive leadership.
Strong analytical and technical capabilities, with the ability to leverage portfolio reporting, data analytics, performance metrics, automation, and artificial intelligence (AI) to improve decision-making, reporting, and operational efficiency.
Knowledge of corporate planning, budgeting, and financial management processes that support effective portfolio management and prioritization.
Familiarity with introducing new products or processes within a regulated environment is considered an asset.
Knowledge of managing and implementing process changes within a unionized workforce environment is considered an asset.
Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain project and portfolio documentation, reports, business cases, and executive-level presentations.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and working within Agile teams is considered an asset.
Proficiency with relevant project and portfolio management tools, including Microsoft Project Professional and Microsoft Project Online (MSPO), is considered an asset.
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, including collaboration, facilitation, influencing, negotiation, and stakeholder engagement.
Strong financial and operational planning capabilities, with the ability to align resources, budgets, and priorities with organizational objectives.

What We Offer You

4 weeks’ vacation.
Comprehensive group health, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family.
Annual performance award of up to 10%.
Defined benefit pension plan.
Employee discounts, wellness programs, and access to professional development resources.

What You Can Expect

This role requires a minimum of 40% on-site presence at 1800 Alta Vista Drive, Ottawa, Ontario or 67 College Street, Toronto, Ontario. Additional on-site work may be required based on business needs. On-site expectations are subject to change and may be adjusted on a temporary or permanent basis.
You will work Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week, 7.5 hours per day.
Travel is required to attend meetings and to fulfill project commitments.

If this role resonates with you, we encourage you to apply by providing your up-to-date resume. This could be your first step towards a meaningful and inspiring career. Come to work each day knowing that you save lives.

We acknowledge that the work of Canadian Blood Services spans many Territories and Treaty areas across the country, and we are grateful for the Traditional Knowledge Keepers and Elders who have guided us in this important work. We recognize the land and waters that have inspired our work and offer gratitude to those Indigenous peoples on whose territory we work, live and play.

jobs.title: Director, AI, Data & Analytics
jobs.description:
The City of North Vancouver is the urban core of the beautiful North Shore and has a long-term vision to be “The Healthiest Small City in the World”, with five key priorities to be a City for People, a Resilient City, a Vibrant City, a Connected City and a Prosperous City. The City of North Vancouver is committed to adopting AI deliberately: grounded in policy, guided by ethics, and accountable to open information principles. We are seeking a Director who is responsible for Artificial Intelligence (AI) governance, and who can deliver transformation from that foundation.

Reporting directly to the Chief Administrative Officer (CAO), this innovative and strategic leadership role will directly shape how artificial intelligence, enterprise data, analytics, and Geographic Information Systems (GIS) transform municipal service delivery. The Director will develop and implement strategies that modernize service delivery, improve organizational performance, and strengthen the City's ability to make informed, data-driven decisions. This is a transformative role that merges business acumen, strategic insight, innovation, and technological expertise to realize the full potential of AI and Data beyond automation and productivity improvement. As the City's steward for the ethical use of AI and data, the Director will build the governance framework, policies, and safeguards that make that transformation trustworthy.

As Director, AI, Data & Analytics, you will provide enterprise leadership for the City’s AI, data, analytics, and GIS functions. Working closely with the CAO, Executive Leadership Team, departmental leaders, and Information Technology Services, you will build the governance, capability, and partnerships that turn strategy into better services for the community.

Key Responsibilities

In this role you will:
Lead the City's responsible AI governance: develop and maintain the AI governance framework, policies, and standards.
Develop and lead the City’s enterprise AI, Data & Analytics Strategy aligned with Council’s Strategic Plan and organizational priorities.
Provide strategic advice to the CAO and Executive Leadership Team on digital innovation, emerging technologies, and enterprise transformation.
Lead enterprise initiatives that improve service delivery, organizational performance, and data-driven decision-making.
Lead enterprise data analytics, business intelligence, and open data initiatives.
Provide strategic leadership for the City’s enterprise Geographic Information Systems (GIS) program and geospatial strategy.
Partner with Information Technology Services to ensure technology investments support business transformation and organizational priorities.
Build organizational capability through AI literacy, data literacy, change management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Lead a multidisciplinary team while managing budgets, resources, strategic partnerships, and enterprise programs.

Qualifications

You are an accomplished leader who combines strategic leadership with strong business acumen and a passion for innovation, with:
Extensive (ten or more years) senior leadership business management experience leading enterprise transformation, innovation, technology, analytics, or digital modernization initiatives.
Five or more years of AI experience in information-intensive industries or digitally advanced enterprises.
Five or more years of progressive experience building collaborative, high-performing teams and fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning.

Experience developing enterprise strategies and cross-organizational programs.
Demonstrated success leading complex organizational change across multiple business functions.
Strong knowledge of artificial intelligence, analytics, GIS, and emerging technologies.
A thorough understanding of responsible AI principles, privacy, security, ethics, and regulatory considerations.
Exceptional relationship-building, communication, and influencing skills with the ability to engage executives, elected officials, staff, and external partners.

Education

Preferably a master’s or Ph.D. in business administration, in statistics, economics, science, technology, engineering, and mathematics or applied mathematics (STEM); computer science; artificial intelligence; data science; information systems or related field; or equivalent work experience. Academic qualification or professional training and experience in legal and regulatory areas are also desirable.

Salary:
We offer an attractive remuneration and benefits package for this exempt position, including a compressed work schedule. The salary range is $156,156.00 to $181,632.00.

During the recruitment process, applicants will be requested to provide a current Police Information Check (PIC).

If you are passionate about making the City of North Vancouver an even greater place to live, work and play, apply on-line through the Career Portal at www.cnv.org by Friday, November 20, 2026.

We are committed to being an inclusive employer—one that reflects the diversity of our community and values the unique contributions of each person. Guided by our core values and Council’s vision for an open and inclusive city, we work to create respectful, safe, and accessible workplaces. We regularly review and improve our hiring practices to help identify and remove barriers. Through ongoing learning, we continue to address any that remain.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates. If you need an accommodation during the selection process, or are having trouble completing or submitting your application, please contact us at hr@cnv.org
. We’re here to support your full participation.

jobs.title: Director, General Operations, Structured Finance
jobs.description:
You desire impactful work.

You’re
RGA ready

RGA is a purpose-driven organization working to solve today’s challenges through innovation and collaboration. A Fortune 200 Company and listed among its World’s Most Admired Companies , we’re the only global reinsurance company to focus primarily on life- and health-related solutions. Join our multinational team of intelligent, motivated, and collaborative people, and help us make financial protection accessible to all.

Coordinates cross functional project teams to develop financing solutions for RGA's regulatory entities. Leads and manages accounting and reporting functions on assigned structured finance transactions. Reviews and analyzes structured finance transaction information ensuring accuracy of data and design. Evaluates and recommends improvements to improve efficiency for internal financing processes.

Principle Duties

Manage a project team of professionals of varying levels (including investments, legal, and other corporate partners as needed) to structure and complete complex reinsurance transactions throughout the global organization. Provide a point of leadership as well as coordinate a collaborative effort to develop optimal solutions to meet legal entity and consolidated objectives.
Assist with coordinating the processes of analyzing transactions through interaction with the various technical experts in structured finance, accounting, legal, investments, tax, etc. Anticipate, identify, and resolve issues that arise during the RGA transaction analysis process to maximize the chance of a successful outcome. Canadian Blood Services is seeking a Regular Full-Time Associate Director, Portfolio Governance and Value Realization
to join our Enterprise Portfolio, Program and Project Management Office (ePMO)
team in our Ottawa or Toronto office.

The ePMO
team delivers programs and services that advance valuable organizational initiatives, ensuring they are completed on time and on budget. Our focus is on maximizing business outcomes for Canadian Blood Services and the people in Canada we serve.

As the Associate Director, Portfolio Governance and Value Realization, you will lead value realization and benefits tracking activities aligned with corporate strategy, corporate funding cycles, and the delivery of high-visibility projects and programs across the organization.

Reporting to the Director, Enterprise Program Enablement & Project Management Office, you will lead ePMO-led value realization activities across enterprise programs and provide guidance to support value-informed decision-making. You will contribute to enterprise portfolio management and reporting for all corporate priority projects, including ePMO projects; escalate issues requiring executive attention; and provide leadership to enterprise projects coordinated through process management. You will also ensure compliance with corporate portfolio reporting requirements and support the execution of select projects within the portfolio by fostering collaboration and integration across divisions. In addition, you will provide a challenge function across other ePMO activities, including reporting, automation and artificial intelligence (AI), data and analytics, and alignment with corporate strategy.

Leveraging your skills in ePMO operations, you will oversee value realization driven through programs, providing leadership, coordination, and management of enterprise PMO processes and functions.

Demonstrating your ability to lead with empathy and emotional intelligence, you will apply the advanced soft skills required to lead and motivate others to achieve deliverables, particularly when priorities and expectations may be in conflict.
Contributing your expertise in strategic initiatives and project leadership, you will take a lead role in developing and maintaining various initiatives and participate in special projects and corporate initiatives as assigned by the Director.

Fostering your strengths in people leadership and talent development, you will create a high-performing, engaged, and inclusive team environment by setting clear expectations, developing talent, supporting career growth and succession planning, and promoting continuous learning, collaboration, and professional development.

A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Science, Public Administration, Health Administration, or a related discipline. Knowledge of managing and implementing process changes within a unionized workforce environment is considered an asset.

Familiarity with Agile methodologies and working within Agile teams is considered an asset.
Proficiency with relevant project and portfolio management tools, including Microsoft Project Professional and Microsoft Project Online (MSPO), is considered an asset.
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, including collaboration, facilitation, influencing, negotiation, and stakeholder engagement.
Strong financial and operational planning capabilities, with the ability to align resources, budgets, and priorities with organizational objectives.

4 weeks’ vacation.
Comprehensive group health, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family.
Annual performance award of up to 10%.

Employee discounts, wellness programs, and access to professional development resources.

new_jobs.title: Director, AI, Data & Analytics
new_jobs.description:
The City of North Vancouver is the urban core of the beautiful North Shore and has a long-term vision to be “The Healthiest Small City in the World”, with five key priorities to be a City for People, a Resilient City, a Vibrant City, a Connected City and a Prosperous City. The City of North Vancouver is committed to adopting AI deliberately: grounded in policy, guided by ethics, and accountable to open information principles. We are seeking a Director who is responsible for Artificial Intelligence (AI) governance, and who can deliver transformation from that foundation.

Reporting directly to the Chief Administrative Officer (CAO), this innovative and strategic leadership role will directly shape how artificial intelligence, enterprise data, analytics, and Geographic Information Systems (GIS) transform municipal service delivery. The Director will develop and implement strategies that modernize service delivery, improve organizational performance, and strengthen the City's ability to make informed, data-driven decisions. This is a transformative role that merges business acumen, strategic insight, innovation, and technological expertise to realize the full potential of AI and Data beyond automation and productivity improvement. As the City's steward for the ethical use of AI and data, the Director will build the governance framework, policies, and safeguards that make that transformation trustworthy.

As Director, AI, Data & Analytics, you will provide enterprise leadership for the City’s AI, data, analytics, and GIS functions. Working closely with the CAO, Executive Leadership Team, departmental leaders, and Information Technology Services, you will build the governance, capability, and partnerships that turn strategy into better services for the community.

Key Responsibilities

In this role you will:
Lead the City's responsible AI governance: develop and maintain the AI governance framework, policies, and standards.
Develop and lead the City’s enterprise AI, Data & Analytics Strategy aligned with Council’s Strategic Plan and organizational priorities.
Provide strategic advice to the CAO and Executive Leadership Team on digital innovation, emerging technologies, and enterprise transformation.
Lead enterprise initiatives that improve service delivery, organizational performance, and data-driven decision-making.
Lead enterprise data analytics, business intelligence, and open data initiatives.
Provide strategic leadership for the City’s enterprise Geographic Information Systems (GIS) program and geospatial strategy.
Partner with Information Technology Services to ensure technology investments support business transformation and organizational priorities.
Build organizational capability through AI literacy, data literacy, change management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Lead a multidisciplinary team while managing budgets, resources, strategic partnerships, and enterprise programs.

Qualifications

You are an accomplished leader who combines strategic leadership with strong business acumen and a passion for innovation, with:
Extensive (ten or more years) senior leadership business management experience leading enterprise transformation, innovation, technology, analytics, or digital modernization initiatives.
Five or more years of AI experience in information-intensive industries or digitally advanced enterprises.
Five or more years of progressive experience building collaborative, high-performing teams and fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning.

Experience developing enterprise strategies and cross-organizational programs.
Demonstrated success leading complex organizational change across multiple business functions.
Strong knowledge of artificial intelligence, analytics, GIS, and emerging technologies.
A thorough understanding of responsible AI principles, privacy, security, ethics, and regulatory considerations.
Exceptional relationship-building, communication, and influencing skills with the ability to engage executives, elected officials, staff, and external partners.

Education

Preferably a master’s or Ph.D. in business administration, in statistics, economics, science, technology, engineering, and mathematics or applied mathematics (STEM); computer science; artificial intelligence; data science; information systems or related field; or equivalent work experience. Academic qualification or professional training and experience in legal and regulatory areas are also desirable.

Salary:
We offer an attractive remuneration and benefits package for this exempt position, including a compressed work schedule. The salary range is $156,156.00 to $181,632.00.

During the recruitment process, applicants will be requested to provide a current Police Information Check (PIC).

If you are passionate about making the City of North Vancouver an even greater place to live, work and play, apply on-line through the Career Portal at www.cnv.org by Friday, November 20, 2026.

We are committed to being an inclusive employer—one that reflects the diversity of our community and values the unique contributions of each person. Guided by our core values and Council’s vision for an open and inclusive city, we work to create respectful, safe, and accessible workplaces. We regularly review and improve our hiring practices to help identify and remove barriers. Through ongoing learning, we continue to address any that remain.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates. If you need an accommodation during the selection process, or are having trouble completing or submitting your application, please contact us at hr@cnv.org
. We’re here to support your full participation.
